title: Solar energy
text: Solar panels convert sunlight into electricity. Solar energy is renewable and produces no direct emissions during operation.

title: Wind energy
text: Wind turbines convert the kinetic energy of moving air into electricity. Wind and solar are renewable energy sources.

title: The water cycle
text: The water cycle includes evaporation, condensation and precipitation. Sunlight warms water, causing evaporation.

title: Photosynthesis
text: Plants use sunlight, water and carbon dioxide during photosynthesis to produce sugars and release oxygen.

title: Ocean tides
text: Ocean tides are driven primarily by the gravitational pull of the Moon and the Sun. Coastal locations experience rising and falling sea levels.

title: Recycling
text: Recycling recovers materials such as paper, glass and metals. Reusing these materials can reduce waste and demand for raw resources.
